chunks: I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they come to me.

key_terms.يَحْضُرُونِ: They come to me / They approach me

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'A'oodhu bika Rabbi an yahduruni'?
ai.summary: This verse, part of the supplication of the believers in Surah Al-Mu'minun, is traditionally recited during prayer to seek refuge from the whisperings of devils and the encroachment of enemies. In Shia scholarly tradition, it underscores the necessity of divine protection against both internal spiritual distractions and external adversarial forces that seek to derail one's faith.
